headword: {大学教員|だいがくきょういん}

definitions.gloss: university faculty member; college instructor; academic staff
definitions.explanation: A person who teaches or conducts research at a university. An umbrella term covering professors, associate professors, lecturers, and assistant professors.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{大学教員|だいがくきょういん}です。
examples.english: My father is a university faculty member.

examples.japanese: {大学教員|だいがくきょういん}は{研究|けんきゅう}と{教育|きょういく}の{両方|りょうほう}を{行|おこな}う。
examples.english: University faculty members carry out both research and teaching.

examples.japanese: {大学教員|だいがくきょういん}の{公募|こうぼ}に{応募|おうぼ}するには、{博士号|はくしごう}と{一定|いってい}の{研究|けんきゅう}{業績|ぎょうせき}が{求|もと}められる。
examples.english: To apply for a university faculty position, a doctoral degree and a certain level of research accomplishment are required.

notes:
A compound of {大学|だいがく} (university) and {教員|きょういん} (teaching staff, instructor). This is the standard general term for any person employed in a teaching or research role at a university, regardless of rank.

Japanese universities have a hierarchy of academic positions: {教授|きょうじゅ} (professor), {准教授|じゅんきょうじゅ} (associate professor), {講師|こうし} (lecturer), and {助教|じょきょう} (assistant professor).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大学教員|だいがくきょういん}の{公募|こうぼ}: open recruitment for faculty positions
- {大学教員|だいがくきょういん}になる: to become a university instructor
- {大学教員|だいがくきょういん}として{働|はたら}く: to work as a university faculty member

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {教授|きょうじゅ}: professor — the highest academic rank
- {研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}: researcher — broader term not limited to university-affiliated roles
- {教師|きょうし}: teacher — more commonly used for primary and secondary school teachers
